items.description: The current conversion executor is a single Python thread in the GUI process and cannot hard-stop a non-cooperative or stuck conversion.
items.containment: Existing sequence and fingerprint guards prevent obsolete result publication, but liveness is not claimed.
items.exit_evidence: Process-isolated worker, one-active-one-latest-pending scheduling, bounded terminate/kill escalation, crash/OOM/malformed-IPC tests, and orphan-free shutdown on every platform.

items.description: Cancellation is cooperative and several whole-document or host-parser intervals cannot acknowledge it promptly.
items.containment: Cancellation publishes no partial current successor and last-known-good C remains protected.
items.exit_evidence: Visible cancel-requested state within 100 ms, 750 ms cooperative grace, worker termination within 2 seconds, and latest pending start within 250 ms after termination.

items.description: Complete generated C, syntax highlighting, mappings, and observer trees are eagerly projected on the GUI thread.
items.containment: Output remains immutable and hidden details avoid some current work, but maximum-input responsiveness is unproved.
items.exit_evidence: Viewport-first generated C, cached position indexes, virtualized/lazy models, no event-loop gap over 100 ms, and first output viewport within 250 ms.

items.description: Mapping projection repeatedly splits output and encodes prefixes for each mapping, producing output-size-by-marker-count work.
items.containment: The visible mapping count is capped, but the algorithm is still unsuitable for large results.
items.exit_evidence: One cached line and UTF-16 index per revision, linear index construction, bounded lookup cost, and maximum-result benchmark.

items.description: Each source edit copies full editor text and synchronously recomputes full source and bundle fingerprints.
items.containment: The current model remains semantically race safe and stale-output safe.
items.exit_evidence: Incremental/debounced revision synchronization with p95 keystroke-to-paint latency at or below 50 ms on the maximum-byte fixture.

items.description: Live Find may rescan the full document and materialize every match and extra selection, including after the panel closes with a retained query.
items.containment: Search is presentation-only and cannot affect conversion semantics.
items.exit_evidence: Debounced cancelable search, bounded viewport/overview markers, one-character high-match-density fixture, and no event-loop gap over 100 ms.

items.description: Bracket matching can scan a whole Qt document character by character on cursor movement, while highlighting has no measured maximum-file mode.
items.exit_evidence: Indexed or bounded bracket matching, measured large-file highlighting, long-line and 100,000-line fixtures, and cursor latency within budget.

items.description: Linked-file hashing, path checks, reads, and external-change assessment can execute on the GUI thread.
items.containment: Writes retain atomic custody and external changes never auto-reload source.
items.exit_evidence: Asynchronous I/O and injected 5-second file-system latency with responsive menus, editing, Cancel, and close.

items.description: Historical workspace naming remains visible in the current active application surface.
items.containment: Historical files remain sealed and are not rewritten.
items.exit_evidence: All new and active front-facing surfaces identify PyCForge; automated and visual audits find no alternate theme-derived product or component label.

items.description: The requested cohesive custom gradient/icon main and context-menu system is not implemented or platform-validated.
items.containment: Existing native actions and SVG assets remain usable.
items.exit_evidence: Shared action registry, custom main/context menus for all declared surfaces, keyboard/mnemonic/high-DPI/screen-edge/accessibility tests, and visible platform evidence.

items.description: The sealed release had no PyQt5 runtime; ten Qt tests skipped and Windows 11 execution was unclaimed.
items.containment: Historical offscreen evidence remains preserved but is not treated as current release evidence.
items.exit_evidence: Passing real visible PyQt gates on Windows 11 and a declared Linux desktop backend, with scaling, keyboard, accessibility, failure, and maximum-input runs.

items.description: The application lacks portions of the authorized IDE-grade editing, navigation, action-discovery, and virtualized inspection experience.
items.containment: Only features explicitly listed in the Checkpoint E boundary may be added.
items.exit_evidence: Bounded vertical feature slices with real widget, keyboard, accessibility, semantic-preservation, and responsiveness evidence.
